answer: Employees are entitled to 25 working days of paid annual leave per year from 1 January 2026, according to the HR Policy Update 2026. The Employee Handbook 2025 still states 22 working days, so the two documents conflict. The newer policy applies, because it states that it replaces the annual leave section (4.1) of the handbook.

answer: Salaries are paid monthly through the UAE Wage Protection System (WPS), on or before the 25th of each month. If the 25th falls on a weekend or public holiday, salaries are paid on the previous working day.

citations.snippet: Salaries are paid through the Wage Protection System (WPS) on or before the 25th of each month.

answer: Standard working hours are 8:00 to 17:00, Monday to Friday, with a one-hour lunch break, which is 40 hours per week. During Ramadan the working day is two hours shorter. Overtime must be approved in advance by a manager and is paid at 125% of the basic hourly wage.

answer: Purchases are approved by amount: up to AED 10,000 by the Department Head, from AED 10,001 to AED 100,000 by the Finance Manager, and above AED 100,000 by the CFO and CEO together. Any purchase above AED 25,000 also needs three written quotations from different suppliers, and splitting a purchase to stay under a limit is not allowed.
